Package com.bupt.ta.ai

Class LmConfig

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.ai.LmConfig
public final class LmConfig extends Object
Immutable snapshot of language-model integration settings for the TA application.

LmConfig is the configuration hub of the LM layer. Settings are loaded once per web application from WEB-INF/lm.properties and environment variables via AppConfig.resolve(java.lang.String, java.lang.String[], java.util.Properties, java.lang.String, java.lang.String), then consumed by LmClientFactory to choose between MockLmClient and HttpLmClient.

Configuration keys (each also accepts a dotted lm.* property name in lm.properties; see load(javax.servlet.ServletContext)):

  • LM_ENABLED — default true; when false, factory returns MockLmClient with forceDisabled and AI features report as disabled
  • LM_PROVIDER — default mock; maps to LmProviderType (mock, openai, custom); unknown values fall back to LmProviderType.MOCK
  • LM_API_KEY — default empty; required with LM_BASE_URL for HTTP providers
  • LM_BASE_URL — default empty; provider API root (no trailing path required)
  • LM_MODEL — default empty; global default model; per-request override via LmRequest.getModel(); HTTP client falls back to LmModelDefaults.CHAT_FALLBACK
  • LM_TIMEOUT_MS — default 30000; HTTP read/connect timeout in milliseconds
  • LM_HTTP_CHAT_PATH — default /chat/completions; appended to getBaseUrl() for OpenAI-compatible chat endpoints

Fallback behaviour: Safe defaults require no outbound network (LmProviderType.MOCK). Boolean and integer parsing uses documented defaults when values are missing or malformed.

  • Method Details

    • load

      public static LmConfig load(javax.servlet.ServletContext ctx)
      Loads LM settings from WEB-INF/lm.properties and environment variables.

      Resolution order for each key is handled by AppConfig.resolve(java.lang.String, java.lang.String[], java.util.Properties, java.lang.String, java.lang.String): environment variables take precedence over servlet properties. Property aliases include both uppercase env-style names and lowercase dotted keys (for example LM_PROVIDER and lm.provider).

      Parameters:
      ctx - servlet context used to locate WEB-INF/lm.properties; must not be null
      Returns:
      a fully constructed LmConfig with safe defaults for missing or invalid values

    • getModel

      public String getModel()
      Returns the default model name (LM_MODEL) for requests that do not specify one.

      When empty, HttpLmClient falls back to LmRequest.getModel() then LmModelDefaults.CHAT_FALLBACK.

      Returns:
      trimmed model identifier, or empty string when not configured

    • getTimeoutMs

      public int getTimeoutMs()
      Returns the HTTP request timeout in milliseconds (LM_TIMEOUT_MS).
      Returns:

    • getHttpChatPath

      public String getHttpChatPath()
      Returns the relative chat completions path (LM_HTTP_CHAT_PATH).

      Appended to getBaseUrl() by HttpLmClient. Defaults to /chat/completions when unset or empty.

      Returns:
      path beginning with /, suitable for OpenAI-compatible APIs

    • hasHttpCredentials

      public boolean hasHttpCredentials()
      Indicates whether an HTTP provider has the minimum credentials to attempt a real call.

      Requires both non-empty getApiKey() and getBaseUrl(). A true result does not guarantee success at runtime (network errors still occur). When false, LmClientFactory falls back to MockLmClient for LmProviderType.OPENAI and LmProviderType.CUSTOM, and HttpLmClient throws LmException if invoked directly.

      Returns:
      true when both API key and base URL are configured
